newsitem.title: UK: Guinness up on options-related trading.
newsitem.headline: Guinness up on options-related trading.

text.p: Shares in Guinness Plc, among the recent worst performers in the FTSE 100, jumped 7-1/2p on Thursday to 447p by 1123 GMT on options related activity, dealers said.
Trading volume in the underlying stock was more than 4.5 million shares.
Dealers said November options on Guinness, which expired yesterday, were exercised, sparking a squeeze in the underlying shares.
Fresh buying in Guinness calls added fuel to the advance.
Dealers noted three big buyers of February 460 calls on Guinness at 12-1/2p and 13p. Some 1,300 lots, equivalent to more than 500,000 shares, were bought in total, they said.
